viewing_check: Check fill level (into neck or lower), capsule and seal intact, no leaks, label condition, and bottle size marking (26 2/3 fl oz or 4/5 quart, 70 proof/ 43% and date clues) to confirm the era. Photograph box condition and any back label or batch code.
